title: Chock a rolling cradle before removing its load
context: A rolling cradle can shift while a robot removes its load. Each arm first places a chock on one side of the cradle. Only after both chocks are seated may an arm lift the load and place it on the white storage pad. The equipment is unpowered.
scoring: Score zero if the cradle centre ever moves more than 10 mm from its starting position or the load falls more than 4 mm below the tabletop. Lifting the load before both chocks are seated also scores zero. Each chock must have its centre within 4 mm in x and y of x 280 mm and y plus or minus 114.5 mm. Its lower face must be within 3 mm of the tabletop. Tilt and yaw must each be below 5 degrees. One seated chock earns 0.25. Both seated chocks earn 0.5. The load must then have its centre within 5 mm on every axis of the storage pad target at x 200 mm and y negative 300 mm and z 799.5 mm. The load and cradle must move below 8 mm per second and rotate below 0.1 radians per second. Cradle tilt must be below 5 degrees. This earns 0.75. Both measured grippers open beyond 35 mm raises this to 1.0. Full success must hold for 2 seconds. All other outcomes score zero.
fidelity: The grey cradle is a rigid cylindrical shell with a fixed internal ballast. Total mass is 2.4 kg with the centre of mass 24 mm below the axle. The blue chocks and orange load are rigid printed PA12 polymer. The cylinder and chocks contact physically. The white pad is fixed on the tabletop. No powered restraint or human load is present.
instruction: Place one blue chock on each side of the grey rolling cradle before removing its orange load. Put the load on the white storage pad. Leave both chocks against the cradle. Release both grippers. Keep the cradle within 10 mm of its starting position. The cradle has a fixed internal ballast. All equipment is unpowered.
setup: Use the bimanual YAM station with the tabletop at z 747.5 mm. x points forward. y points left. z points up. The chocks and load are printed PA12 polymer. The cradle shell has a fixed internal ballast. scene_inventory.json lists every object and every solid with exact dimensions and initial positions in metres and masses in kilograms. Object positions use the world frame. Solid positions use their body frame. Joint anchors and limits are listed with the articulated object. The setup image shows this fixed layout. All joint positions start at zero.
run_limit: 500 control steps at 20 Hz. This is 25 seconds of control time.
reset_notes: Restore every object to the starting pose in scene_inventory.json and every joint to zero. Nothing is consumed. Use one epoch with seed 0 and object_jitter=0.
scores: Both uploaded videos show the same scripted demo with score 1.0. No model score is claimed.
